messages:
simon: Quick sync — observability console roadmap milestone for next sprint. Need owners on: 1) error-analysis view (query + UX) 2) tracing hooks (frontend + backend) 3) retention cutover plan. Infra schema change (fk: logs.metadata) is currently blocking retention migration, @rahul can you confirm ETA? Also flagging CR review for trace-injector PR #587.

maria: i'm +1 to owning error-analysis view but need a design handoff — @alyssa can you share the latest mock? If not, i'll file a spike ticket.

rahul: infra schema deployed to staging yesterday but blocked on db migration window. ETA for production migration is Fri EOD unless we carve a small window tomorrow AM. calling out performance runbook before cutover.

alyssa: mock here: https://figma.com/s/obs-error-104 (draft). i'll drop a short doc with expected metrics. can we get product acceptance criteria by wed?

simon: thanks — i'll add acceptance criteria template. @rahul please post migration runbook link. also can someone pick up trace-injector CR #587? it's small but touches sampling.

rahul: runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/obs-retention-mig.md — added rollback steps. pinged infra for the maintenance window.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2024-12-04T10:12:03Z: schema-change-staging succeeded :white_check_mark:

maria: i'll take CR #587 tomorrow morning, @simon will you handle canary dashboards after it's merged?

simon: yep will create a quick dashboard template and wire alerts (error rate > 0.5% over 5m). Filing follow-ups: OBS-342 (owners + AC), OBS-343 (retention cutover).

alyssa: noted, will review the template. one question — do we want retention to be 30d or 90d for traces? product preference?

maria: pref 90d for now but let's put in config to change per-customer.

simon: ok locking 90d as default. next step owners to update tickets by EOD Tue. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
